einzeiler: Scott Yager and Devin Walker talk fantasy football, draft strategies, and league quirks.
kurzfassung: Scott Yager and Devin Walker team up to talk fantasy football ahead of their patron league. They share draft tactics like cross-referencing Vegas odds and stacking positions. They also debate player values, sleepers, and bust candidates for the upcoming season.
stichpunkte: Scott Yager and Devin Walker preview the upcoming fantasy football season and discuss draft strategies.
Devin highlights his high-stakes league with no rules where trading equity and renting players are allowed.
The hosts discuss the appeal of fantasy football formats like guillotine leagues and dynasty leagues.
Devin shares a strategy of cross-referencing player futures odds in Vegas with their standard draft rankings.
The hosts debate the value of taking quarterbacks and tight ends early versus waiting until later rounds.
They discuss regression candidates, buy-low wide receivers like Chris Godwin, and fading specific rookies.
Devin names Brock Bowers as his top league-winning sleeper at tight end.
